items.description: Verify function signature accepts tasks list and dependencies list, returns list of strings
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(tasks: list[str], dependencies: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[str] is callable and returns a list

items.description: Verify multiple independent dependency chains are ordered deterministically
items.expected_behavior: Multiple independent chains respect internal ordering and use lexicographic selection for cross-chain ordering

items.description: Verify diamond-shaped dependency graph resolves correctly
Verify ValueError raised for duplicate task names
Verify ValueError raised when dependency references unknown task
Verify ValueError raised for circular dependency
Verify TypeError raised when tasks parameter is not a list
Verify TypeError raised when dependencies parameter is not a list
Verify TypeError raised when task name is not a string
Verify TypeError raised when dependency is not a pair of strings
Verify task names are case-sensitive
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['Task', 'task'], []) treats them as distinct tasks

items.description: Verify all tasks from input appear exactly once in output
items.expected_behavior: Output list contains all input tasks with no duplicates

items.description: Verify function returns ordering only without executing tasks
items.expected_behavior: Function returns list of task names without side effects or file operations

items.description: Verify self-referential dependency raises ValueError
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a'], [('a', 'a')]) raises ValueError for circular dependency

items.description: Verify complex graph with multiple paths to same node
items.expected_behavior: Tasks with multiple dependency paths are scheduled after all prerequisites

items.description: Verify dependency ordering is respected for simple linear chain
items.expected_behavior: For dependencies (A, B), A appears before B in output. Example: fetch_data before clean_data before train_model before evaluate_model

items.description: Verify lexicographically largest task is selected first when multiple tasks are available
Verify deterministic output across multiple invocations with same input
items.expected_behavior: Multiple calls with identical inputs produce identical outputs

items.description: Verify empty tasks and dependencies returns empty list
Verify single task with no dependencies returns that task
Verify multiple independent tasks return in lexicographic order (largest first)
Verify long linear dependency chain maintains correct order
items.expected_behavior: Long chain of dependencies (A->B->C->D->E) returns tasks in dependency order

summary: Test plan for Task Scheduler module covering API shape, normal behavior, edge cases, error handling, and boundary conditions for topological task ordering.
